title: The Day Off Plan
old_caption: A day off with a 37-step plan isn't really a day off. Rest doesn't need to be finished or checked. Pick one nice thing and let the rest wander.

title: Nobody to Ask
old_caption: No one around to ask which ornament looks better? You don't need a second vote. Start with what you like. Your taste has always been enough.

title: Just for the Holidays
old_caption: When it's cold and quiet, a "just for the holidays" offer can sound tempting. Lonely isn't a reason to say yes. Say what you want, kindly, and wait for real.

title: Nobody Could Come
old_caption: Everyone bailed on the trip? You're good company too. Go anyway, see the thing, and send the view to the friends who couldn't make it.

title: You Can Cover, Right?
old_caption: Being single doesn't make your time spare. Your plans count, even the solo ones. You can still help out on your terms by offering a day that works for you.

title: The Friend Dinner
old_caption: No date this year, and a table full of friends instead. Friendship is a real kind of love. Save this for whoever's hosting your friend dinner.

title: Movie Night for One
old_caption: Crying at a movie, alone, under a blanket, and loving every minute. Feeling things on your own still counts. Your own company can be the coziest plan.

title: Skating Solo
old_caption: Trying something new with nobody to hold onto is scary. Hold the rail, that's what it's for. Fall, laugh, try again. You can be your own steady.

title: A Gift for Me
old_caption: Buying yourself a little gift can feel silly. It isn't. Keep it small, kind and in budget, then wrap it properly. Yes, you get a bow too.

title: Nine Hellos
old_caption: Lots of hellos and still lonely? Quick texts don't always fill the gap. Pick one friend and actually call. One real conversation goes a long way.
